answer.book: Single work: Jean Daillé's Latin Apologia for the national synods of Alençon (1637) and Charenton (1645), Amsterdam 1655, with a preface by David Blondel, a synopsis, an index of scriptural passages, and a Pars-divided Apologia whose sections are numbered and titled in the Pars headings.
